{
  "derived_under_policy": "SPK-001",
  "workpad_schema": "pfp.po035-public-workpad.v1",
  "prompt_id": "pilot_0000199:po035:experiment-v1:scratchpad:02",
  "stage": "workpad_draft",
  "public_records": [
    {
      "record_id": "r001",
      "carrier": "PO035 conditional scope",
      "kind": "definition",
      "expression": "E_a(t,x)=min(1,C_a exp[-mu_a (||x||_1-a*v_hop(a)*t)/a]) for t>=0",
      "justification": "Given envelope from prompt; a=lattice pitch, v_hop(a)=hop velocity scale",
      "status": "PROPOSED"
    },
    {
      "record_id": "r002",
      "carrier": "Uniform assumptions",
      "kind": "assumption",
      "expression": "c=1 fixed; a>0; mu_a>0; t>=0; x in Z^n; ||x||_1 L1 norm; dilation acts on (t,x) as (lambda*t, lambda*x); v_hop(a) independent of lambda",
      "justification": "Explicitly stated to separate dilation from lattice pitch",
      "status": "PROPOSED"
    },
    {
      "record_id": "r003",
      "carrier": "L1 radius at t=1,x=(1,1)",
      "kind": "calculation",
      "expression": "l1_radius = ||x||_1 = 2",
      "justification": "L1 norm of (1,1) is 1+1=2",
      "status": "PROPOSED"
    },
    {
      "record_id": "r004",
      "carrier": "Euclidean radius squared at t=1,x=(1,1)",
      "kind": "calculation",
      "expression": "euclidean_radius_squared = 1^2+1^2 = 2",
      "justification": "Standard Euclidean sum of squares",
      "status": "PROPOSED"
    },
    {
      "record_id": "r005",
      "carrier": "Interval before at t=1,x=(1,1)",
      "kind": "calculation",
      "expression": "interval_before = c*c*t*t - sum(x_i*x_i) = 1*1 - 2 = -1",
      "justification": "Signature metric with c=1; negative means spacelike separation",
      "status": "PROPOSED"
    },
    {
      "record_id": "r006",
      "carrier": "Interval after at t=1,x=(1,1)",
      "kind": "calculation",
      "expression": "interval_after = c*c*t*t - sum(x_i*x_i) = -1",
      "justification": "Same computation; interval is invariant under dilation",
      "status": "PROPOSED"
    },
    {
      "record_id": "r007",
      "carrier": "Null envelope at t=1,x=(1,0), C_a=1/4,mu_a=1",
      "kind": "calculation",
      "expression": "null_envelope = C_a*exp[-mu_a*(||x||_1 - a*v_hop(a)*t)/a] with ||x||_1=1, t=1 => 1/4*exp[-(1 - a*v_hop(a))/a]",
      "justification": "Exact rational arithmetic licensed; exponential term left in symbolic form per license",
      "status": "PROPOSED"
    },
    {
      "record_id": "r008",
      "carrier": "Cone order preserved for dilated pair",
      "kind": "law_check",
      "expression": "Dilation (t,x)->(lambda*t,lambda*x) preserves homogeneous cone relation: if x-y in cone then lambda*(x-y) in cone. True for L1 and Euclidean cones.",
      "justification": "Homogeneity of the forward light cone under uniform scaling",
      "status": "PROPOSED"
    }
  ],

    "Determine whether causal order alone identifies the Minkowski metric scale (c) or only its conformal class.",
